plan.understanding: Add a 2 mm wide rectangular perimeter flange flush with the existing flat bottom and 0.5 mm thick inward, leave its center open, then cut four 0.5 mm diameter corner mounting holes.

subtasks.goal: On the single body, add a rectangular perimeter flange anchored to flat bottom face #11 at z=-0.75, around the original footprint bounded by side faces #10, #12, #13 and #14 (x=-1.0..1.0, y=-3.0..3.0). Make the flange 2.0 mm wide outward on every side, giving an outer footprint x=-3.0..3.0 and y=-5.0..5.0, while leaving the central x=-1.0..1.0 by y=-3.0..3.0 region unfilled by the flange. Because it 'starts on' face #11, keep its underside flush at z=-0.75 and run its 0.5 mm thickness inward to z=-0.25; verify the final body remains z=-0.75..0.75 and print the achieved flange bounds, correcting them in the same attempt if necessary.

Cut four through mounting holes of diameter 0.5 mm through only the new flange thickness z=-0.75..-0.25, with axes normal to bottom face #11 (normal [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]). Locate their centers 0.6 mm inward from the flange's outer x and y edges, at (x,y)=(2.4,4.4), (2.4,-4.4), (-2.4,4.4) and (-2.4,-4.4) mm. Print all four achieved center coordinates and diameters and correct any misplaced instance within the same attempt.
